notLevied.why: No payroll tax (3000) in Viet Nam. The trade union fee (kinh phí công đoàn, 2 % of the social-insurance wage fund; Luật Công đoàn 50/2024/QH15 art. 29 (1) (b), read in lexifina/vietnam-law) is a financial source of the trade union, not general government: not a tax (OECD Interpretative Guide §6); grade B
Viet Nam has no separate inheritance, estate or gift tax: inheritances and gifts are personal income (PIT Law 04/2007 arts. 3 (10), 16, 23 (2); consolidated 28/VBHN-VPQH 2025), modelled under 1100
Net wealth tax: not levied in 2025 (R3 registry, registry/ASIA_PACIFIC.json: none); grade B, no statute text read for the negative
